title: Software Engineer Intern, Payments (Summer 2027)
content: <h2>About Saguaro Pay</h2><p>Saguaro Pay builds payment infrastructure for small businesses across the Southwest. Merchants use our APIs to accept cards, send payouts and reconcile every dollar.</p><h2>About the team</h2><p>The Payments Core team owns the ledger and the event-driven systems that move money between merchants, banks and card networks.</p><h2>What you'll do</h2><ul><li>Build services in Java or Go that process payment events from Kafka.</li><li>Make retries safe so a merchant is never charged twice when a message is delivered more than once.</li><li>Write SQL against our Postgres ledger and add tests for every change.</li><li>Ship to production through our CI/CD pipeline and watch your own dashboards.</li></ul><h2>Minimum qualifications</h2><ul><li>Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.</li><li>Experience with Java, Go or Python from classes, projects or internships.</li><li>A solid grasp of data structures and algorithms.</li><li>Curiosity about distributed systems and how Kafka-style event streaming works.</li><li>Clear written communication.</li></ul><h2>Preferred qualifications</h2><ul><li>Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.</li><li>You've built something that handles money, even a class project.</li></ul><h2>Pay and benefits</h2><p>The hourly rate for this internship is $42 per hour. Interns work in our Tempe office three days a week for 12 weeks starting in May 2027.</p><p>Saguaro Pay is an equal opportunity employer.</p>
